narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Subtracting always makes a number smaller, so it cannot match adding.
<bookmark mark='longer'/>Look at the lift. It climbs three floors and then seven floors, which is longer than seven floors.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Taking away a negative number made the answer bigger, so subtracting does not always make smaller.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Taking away a negative number gives the same answer as adding the matching positive number.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Work out positive nine minus negative two. Which addition gives the same answer?
